sections.h2: Where do you record a deed in Boyd County, Kentucky?
sections.html:
You record it with the Boyd County Clerk. The main office is in the courthouse at 2800 Louisa Street in Catlettsburg, and the county lists two branch offices in Ashland, so a seller on the Ashland side of the county does not have to drive to the seat.

  • Main office, 2800 Louisa Street, Catlettsburg, 606-739-5116, weekdays 8:30 a.m. to 4 p.m.
  • Ashland office, 1505 Carter Avenue, Suite 100, 606-325-3547, weekdays 9:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
  • Cannonsburg office, 1315 Cannonsburg Road, 606-929-9595, weekdays 9 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.

The county page says holidays may change those hours. It also says the clerk records land records, wills, liens and lien releases, along with articles of incorporation and veterans discharges. Call the branch before you drive if you are bringing a deed that needs a notary.

sections.h2: What is Boyd County like for a seller?
sections.html:
Boyd County is a small, dense county on the Ohio River at the northeastern edge of Kentucky, about 160 square miles of land. Ashland is the largest city, Catlettsburg is the seat, and the county sits in the Huntington-Ashland metro area. The Census Bureau counts 301.9 people per square mile, far more crowded than a typical Bluegrass county.

Steel, refining and activated carbon have been the big employers, and the county's population has slid from about 55,500 in 1980 to an estimated 47,751 in 2025. Older houses, some with deferred repairs, are common in the river towns. Three school districts serve the county: Boyd County Public Schools, Ashland Independent and Fairview Independent, and a buyer will ask which one covers your address.

sections.h2: What does the Boyd County Clerk charge to record?
sections.html:
The clerk's fee schedule, effective January 1, 2020, lists a deed at $50 and a mortgage at $80. Extra pages and extra parcel references add to the total, so call 606-739-5116 for a current figure.

Selected Boyd County Clerk recording fees (clerk fee schedule effective January 1, 2020)
DocumentFee
Deed or condo deed$50.00
Deed of correction$46.00
Mortgage$80.00
Release of mortgage$46.00
Affidavit of descent or distribution$50.00
Will$47.00
Judgment lien$46.00
Plat$50.00

Most items add $3.00 for every page past the first five, and some add $4.00 for each additional reference listed. A mortgage adds the $3.00 charge only after thirty pages.

sections.h2: How is the transfer tax figured in Boyd County?
sections.html:
The clerk's schedule states the transfer tax as $1.00 for every $1,000, which matches the state rate of fifty cents per $500 of value or fraction. The grantor named in the deed pays it, and the clerk collects it when the deed is presented.

With a Census median owner-occupied value of $130,700 for 2020 to 2024, a sale near that figure is 262 units of $500 and the tax is $131.00. A $90,000 sale is 180 units and $90.00. Because Boyd County values run low, the tax is often a smaller line on the settlement statement than the title fees.

No tax applies when a house is transferred by foreclosure, between spouses, or between parent and child for only nominal consideration. If you are unsure whether your transfer qualifies, ask the clerk before you sign, since the clerk cannot accept the deed without the right amount.

sections.h2: What has to be in a deed before the clerk will accept it?
sections.html:
Kentucky lists the required contents in KRS 382.135. A deed must carry full names and mailing addresses for both sides, the full consideration, and an address where the current tax bill can be sent.

  • A sale needs a sworn, notarized certificate that the stated price is the price paid.
  • A gift needs a certificate saying so, plus an estimated fair cash value.
  • The deed must refer to the recorded deed or other source by which the seller got title.
  • The clerk may not file a deed that fails these rules.

The grantor's recorded source of title is the item most often missing from do-it-yourself deeds. If your deed came from a family member years ago and was never recorded, tell your closing attorney early, since a gap there can hold up a cash closing.

sections.h2: How do inherited Boyd County homes get recorded?
sections.html:
The personal representative of the estate files an affidavit with the county clerk naming who receives each property and its value. The Boyd County schedule lists that affidavit at $50. A will recorded with the clerk costs $47 on the same schedule.

Estates can sit for months with a house unlisted and utilities running. A buyer who pays cash still needs the record to show who owned the property and who received it. Start with the affidavit, then ask the clerk or an attorney which other papers the county needs.

sections.h2: Who handles delinquent property taxes in Boyd County?
sections.html:
The Boyd County Clerk's office takes over delinquent taxes from prior years. The county's property tax page says to call 606-739-5116 and press option 4 to pay them.

Current-year bills are collected by the Sheriff's Office instead, so an unpaid prior year bill is a clerk matter and this year's bill is a sheriff matter. A closing agent will check both before a sale funds, and a seller who knows of a delinquent bill should ask the clerk for the payoff amount.

sections.h2: What do the Census numbers say about Boyd County housing?
sections.html:
Census figures for 2020 to 2024 show 70.2% owner-occupied housing, a median gross rent of $849 and a median household income of $61,118. About 18.0% of residents live in poverty, and the mean commute is 22.1 minutes. The county had roughly 21,818 housing units in 2025 and issued only 12 building permits that year.

Few new homes and many older ones mean sellers compete mostly with other resale houses. That makes a clean title and a complete deed package the part you control.

faqs.q: How do I contact the Boyd County Clerk?
faqs.a: Call 606-739-5116 for the main office at 2800 Louisa Street in Catlettsburg. The Ashland office is 606-325-3547 and the Cannonsburg office is 606-929-9595.

faqs.q: How much does a deed cost to record in Boyd County?
faqs.a: The clerk's schedule effective January 1, 2020 lists $50 for a deed, plus $3 for each page after the fifth. Call to confirm the current amount.

faqs.q: What is the transfer tax in Boyd County?
faqs.a: It is $1.00 for every $1,000 of value on the clerk's schedule, the same as the state rate of $0.50 per $500. The seller named in the deed pays it.

faqs.q: Can I record in the Ashland office instead of Catlettsburg?
faqs.a: The county lists Ashland and Cannonsburg offices under the County Clerk, and the county page says the clerk's office records land records. Call the branch first to confirm it will take your document.

faqs.q: Where do I pay delinquent Boyd County property taxes from a prior year?
faqs.a: Pay them through the County Clerk's office at 606-739-5116, option 4. The Sheriff's Office collects the current year.
